newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ wholesale electricity prices fall in Dec - EMCO.
newsitem.headline: NZ wholesale electricity prices fall in Dec - EMCO.

text.p: Average wholesale New Zealand electricity prices in December fell in both the North and South Islands compared with November prices, electricity market operator EMCO said on Tuesday.

The average wholesale electricity price for the South Island (at the Benmore reference point) in December fell to 2.62 cents per kilowatt hour compared with 2.82 cents in November, 3.12 cents in October and 4.02 cents in September before the open market began.
The highest South Island price in December was 10.45 cents (12.49 cents in November) and the lowest price was 0.10 cents (1.54 cents in November).
In the North Island (at the Haywards reference point), the average price fell to 3.64 cents a kilowatt hour from 4.27 cents in November, 3.90 cents in October and 3.94 cents in September.
The highest North Island price in December was 15.01 cents compared with 15.12 cents in November and 15.52 cents in October.
The lowest price was 0.11 cents compared with 1.69 cents in November and 2.00 cents in October.
EMCO said final prices for January were due to be published on or before February 13.
